title: Sarbacher: craft at Wright-Patterson taken over by Anderson trust, MIT's Compton
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Sarbacher: craft at Wright-Patterson taken over by Anderson trust, MIT's Compton, about 1940s-1960s at Wright-Patterson AFB, Ohio, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: sarbacher says that uh uh there was a craft being held at rright Patterson and that craft was taken over by uh the Anderson trust

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a government scientist named Robert Sarbacher claimed a craft was being held at Wright-Patterson, an Air Force base in Ohio, sometime between the 1940s and 1960s. According to Michels, Sarbacher said the craft was taken over by a group called the Anderson trust, with a link to Karl Compton, a leading scientist at MIT, the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. If true, it would mean a recovered craft passed out of plain military hands into a private circle of scientists.
